g.text: Puerto Rico radar quality and study regions — 2021

text.style: font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif

g.text: RQI describes radar precipitation-quality uncertainty from beam blockage and beam height relative to the melting layer.

text.style: font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif

g.text: Higher scores indicate more favorable sampling; the mean includes valid zero scores and excludes missing pixels.

text.style: font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif

g.text: The black boundary marks valid reflectivity in at least 1% of successfully read hourly samples;

text.style: font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif

g.text: its position depends on weather and data availability, rather than a fixed radar-range limit.
